description: Lets an outside system such as a form tool, a website, GitHub or Stripe create or update records in a list by posting JSON to a secret URL. Each endpoint belongs to one list and maps JSON paths of the body to its fields; mode upsert updates the record whose match field equals the mapped value and creates one otherwise. action fields lists the fields a mapping can fill. action create requires typeId, name and mapping and returns webhook.url, the secret address that receives POST requests. With signingSecret set, every request must carry an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body in signatureHeader. Requests larger than 256 KB or arriving too fast are refused. action test shows what a body would write, field by field, without writing anything; action deliveries shows the delivery log with the outcome of each request. action update with rotateUrl true replaces the secret address. action delete is IRREVERSIBLE. Records are created as the member who created the endpoint, with the endpoint named as their source. Incoming webhooks need a plan with webhooks on the cloud and work on every self-hosted workspace.

action.description: Incoming webhook operation. Keys per action: list: typeId; get: id; fields: typeId; create: typeId, name, mapping, enabled, signatureHeader, signingSecret, samplePayload; update: id, name, mapping, enabled, signatureHeader, signingSecret, samplePayload, rotateUrl; delete: id; test: id, payload; deliveries: id, limit.

id.description: The incoming webhook id. Required for every action except list, fields and create.

limit.description: deliveries only. How many recent deliveries, default 25.

mapping.description: How the JSON body fills the list: mode create or upsert, matchFieldId (upsert only: the mapped field that finds the existing record) and fields, each a JSON path such as data.email and the fieldId it fills. Required for create; on update it replaces the stored mapping.

fieldId.description: The field of the list that receives the value.

path.description: Where the value sits in the JSON body, such as data.email or items[0].name.

matchFieldId.description: For upsert: the mapped field whose value finds the existing record. Null for create.

mode.description: create adds a record for every request; upsert updates the record that matches.

name.description: A name for the endpoint; the records it creates name it as their source.

payload.description: test only. The body to try; defaults to the stored samplePayload.

rotateUrl.description: update only. true replaces the secret URL; the old URL stops working.

anyOf.description: A JSON object, such as the body another system posts to the endpoint.

samplePayload.description: An example body kept with the endpoint for test.

signatureHeader.description: Header that carries the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body. Default x-signature.

signingSecret.description: When set, every request must carry a valid signature in signatureHeader. update: omit to keep, null to clear. The secret is not returned.

typeId.description: The list whose records the webhook creates or updates. Required for fields and create; optional for list.

name: manage_incoming_webhooks

outputSchema.description: list returns items; get, create and update return webhook with its secret url; delete returns deleted; test returns preview, what the mapping would write for the body without writing it; deliveries returns the recent deliveries; fields returns the fields of the list a mapping can fill.

title: Manage incoming webhooks
